rootCriterionClarification: One actually tested maintained tool/runtime pair suffices; exhaustive execution across all maintained series/minors/patches is not required. Pair must be supported by primary policy, and SDK execution must be direct, not inferred from closure.

nonEolVersions.summary: The public-main Gson test derivation actually invokes Maven3.10.0 with JDK21.0.12.1+1 and succeeds. Maven primary history identifies3.10.0 as maintained, and3.10.0 release notes require Java8 or newer. This one executed supported pair satisfies the clarified criterion; missing3.9.16 execution on this public snapshot limits breadth but no longer makes the criterion not-met. No other version range or producer revision is substituted.

policyObservations.history: Latest version in each of two GA series maintained; current exact versions3.10.0/3.9.16.
policyObservations.releaseNotes: Maven3.10.0 runs on Java8 or newer.
policyObservations.captureMethod: Fresh official primary-page web reads; Maven history also separately captured in maven-policy-clarification.json.

maven-purifier.supersedes: Only earlier criterion judgment requiring execution of both maintained Maven series; primary policy facts and original packet remain unchanged.

nonEolVersions.summary: Elixir1.18 is explicitly security-maintained, so lack of1.20/other minor execution is not a failure under the clarified rule. However the actual public Credo test derivation executes Elixir1.18.5 with Erlang/OTP28.5.0.8; primary current Elixir compatibility table lists OTP25–27 for Elixir1.18. The1.18.5 release note is a security fix and gives no OTP28 support exception. Native test success is demonstrated, but an upstream-supported maintained pair is not established for this actual SDK selection. No unexecuted OTP27 alternative is inferred.

policyObservations.primaryCompatibilityPage: Security support table includes1.18. Erlang/OTP compatibility table row1.18 lists25–27; no28 exception in that row.
policyObservations.patchRelease: Primary v1.18.5 GitHub release body only describes security fix CVE-2026-75758; no additional OTP28 compatibility claim.
